entries.name: Futanari anatomy
entries.content:

entries.name: Futanari youth

entries.name: Futanari Myth and Notable Futanari
entries.content:
[ In order to keep their identity as futanari secret most futanari have carefully constructed facades they adopt when mingling in society these tend to differ wildly from their actual personalities for better or worse. ]

[ Unknown to even futanari is the fact that the mythical Immortal witch that helped shape their community is not a myth at all but is in fact world famous pianist Glinda Nightroad. Glinda's name and personality are way different from what they were in the year 15XX and she now believes that futanari are superior to the rest of humanity even though her true identity and status as a futanari remain unknown to everyone. ]

[ In an attempt to bring her kind out of the shadows a youtuber named Clara claiming to be a futanari has hit the internet and taken the world by storm although she is popular with most normal people most of which do not believe her claim about being a futanari she is hated by most futanari who see her as a threat to their peaceful coexistence. ]

entries.name: Authority figures and Symbols of Power
entries.content:
[ The Mabase Conglomerate is a collective of businesses and services currently spearheaded by Yumi Mabase and formerly her mother Haruka Mabase. To the public eye they are a force of great influence touching many industries all the way from food to hospitals and technological advancements however unbeknownst to the masses the Mabase Conglomerate is actually run by futanari and makes moves towards the further advancement of futanarikind from the shadows. ]

[ Yumi Mabase is the current head of the Mabase Conglomerate and there was much controversy surrounding her appointment since unlike most futanari she does not possess male genitalia she does however still share all of the other traits of her kin including strength, libido and stature. Under her leadership the futanari community is currently enjoying a renaissance of sorts which as eliminated most doubt in her capabilities. ]

entries.name: Futanari Schools
keys: Saint Anne's School For Exceptional Girls
entries.content:
[ Saint Anne's School For Exceptional Girls is one of institutions of higher learning for futanari there are several locations throughout the world and is the school most futanari attend. The staff is largely comprised of adult futanari with exceptions being made for anthros or for normals that have some how learned of the secret world of futanari existence ]

[ All Futanari run schools are known as all girl schools to the human populace and thought to have very stringent admission prerequisites this is used to keep normals from being enrolled at all cost which gives all these schools a high degree of prestige and mystique ]

[ Our Immortal Lady's Providence is an academy established by Glinda unbeknownst to it's faculty and student body the name comes from Glinda's former moniker "Immortal Witch" Glinda herself is rarely involved with the school in recent years making infrequent appearances usually at the beginning and end of the school year respectively to give formal addresses to the student body ]

[ The Mabase All Girls Institute is the most common school for futanari youth of all walks of life to attend with locations of the same name all over the world it is the easiest to attend and is backed by the Mabase Conglomerate ]

[ All futanari run schools accommodate for education from grades K-12 after which most futanari are deemed ready to cohabitate with the human populace although some will opt to pursue higher education at a privately run futanari university ]
